expectations.text: Preserves 18 nurses, four weeks, one clinic, and voluntary participation.
expectations.evidence: “A voluntary four-week pilot at one clinic”; “18 participating nurses”.

expectations.text: Preserves median weekly 46 to 39 minutes with no causal claim and explains no control plus concurrent staffing changes.
expectations.evidence: “median weekly scheduling time fell from 46 to 39 minutes”; “cannot establish that the tool caused the reduction: there was no control group, and concurrent staffing changes may explain part of it.”

expectations.text: States six of nine survey respondents preferred it rather than six of 18 or a majority of all nurses.
expectations.evidence: “Six of the nine nurses who returned the optional survey preferred the tool”; it explicitly rejects generalizing to all participants or elsewhere.

expectations.text: States patient safety was not measured; any next step is framed as recommendation, not a planned commitment.
expectations.evidence: “Patient safety was not measured. Before considering wider adoption, run a longer evaluation”. This imperative is a recommendation to the director, not a claim that a study is already planned.
